UnderstandingPrompt: Army formation tendency means that target clan lords who already satisfy native army-forming eligibility become more or less inclined to form an army instead of choosing another AI behavior. It only scales native candidate scores already marked WillGatherArmy. It grants no influence, creates no summonable members, bypasses none of the native conditions involving peace, food, party size, non-mercenary status or not being in an existing army, and does not disband existing armies. Generic strengthening of military power, increasing influence, expanding parties or improving army combat strength does not qualify without changing lords' proactive army-formation decisions.
EvaluationPrompt: Judge percentage changes relative to native eligible army-formation candidate scores, not absolute probability. Mild encouragement or restrictions usually use ±10% to ±25%. Explicit encouragement, official obligations or regular institutional pushes suggest about +50%; strong army mobilization about +75% to +100%. Near-mandatory mobilization that retains native eligibility and AI competition may reach +150%; +200% is the total intensity ceiling. Inhibitory policies use negatives on the same scale; -100% zeroes the target clans' new army-formation candidate scores. Add active-policy percentages first; the runtime total multiplier is limited to 0 to 3. +100% is strong and should not be an ordinary default.
